name: cypress-e2e
description: Proyecto de automatización E2E con Cypress y TypeScript

scripts.cy:run:taller5:spec1: npm run allure:clean & npm run cy:run:headed -- --spec "cypress/e2e/clase5/01-login-fixture.cy.ts" & npm run allure:generate & npm run allure:open
scripts.cy:run:taller5:spec22: npm run allure:clean & npm run cy:run:headed -- --spec "cypress/e2e/clase5/02-login-data-driven-allure.cy.ts" & npm run allure:generate & npm run allure:open
scripts.allure:generate2: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('artifacts/allure-report', { recursive: true, force: true });" && npx allure generate artifacts/allure-results --output artifacts/allure-report --open
scripts.allure:generate: rmdir /s /q artifacts\allure-report & npx allure generate --output artifacts\allure-report && npx allure open artifacts\allure-report
scripts.allure:clean-generate: rimraf artifacts/allure-report && npx allure generate --output artifacts\allure-report && npx allure open artifacts\allure-report
scripts.allure:generate:ci: rimraf artifacts/allure-report & npx allure generate --output artifacts\allure-report
